name: Kodus
tagline: Open-source AI code review built to run where the organization controls: self-hosted or cloud, models under your keys, org-wide Kody Rules.
pricing: Free Community cloud tier (BYOK, up to 10 Kody Rules); Teams $10/dev/mo + your token costs; Enterprise custom; self-hosting free under AGPL
selfHostedNote: Free under AGPL via Docker Compose, VM, or Kubernetes/Helm; no seat minimums; optional daily heartbeat can be disabled.
modelControl: BYOK on every plan: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Vertex, Novita, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM/Ollama); zero token markup

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Repo-level analysis plus linked sibling repos; pulls business context from Jira, Linear, and Notion.

02-rule-centric.note: Plain-language Kody Rules with global-repo-directory scope; auto-imports .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, etc.

03-dual-workflow.note: Reviews run via CLI locally, in CI, and on PRs; distinct local-vs-PR behavior modes not detailed publicly.

04-business-logic.note: Pulls context from Jira, Linear, and Notion to check a PR against what the ticket asked for.

05-continuous-learning.note: Kody generates rules automatically by analyzing team review history; rules and review history persist.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No documented sandbox execution or runtime validation of findings.

07-economic-transparency.note: BYOK on every plan, zero token markup, published cost estimates, token-usage dashboard.

08-actionability.note: Provides fix suggestions in reviews; one-click commit flow not verified in the posts we checked.

09-measurable-roi.note: Token-cost and usage dashboard documented; DORA-style ROI reporting not verified in public posts.
